-- ===================== HyperX.vs - STARTUP INTRO =====================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local LP2 = Players.LocalPlayer
	local TweenService2 = game:GetService("TweenService")
	local SoundService2 = game:GetService("SoundService")

	local splashGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	splashGui.Name = "NEXUSHUBSplash"
	splashGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	splashGui.DisplayOrder = 999
	splashGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	if not pcall(function() splashGui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") end) then
		splashGui.Parent = LP2:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	end

	local overlay = Instance.new("Frame", splashGui)
	overlay.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
	overlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
	overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	overlay.BorderSizePixel = 0
	overlay.ZIndex = 1

	local tapHint = Instance.new("TextLabel", splashGui)
	tapHint.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
	tapHint.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -36)
	tapHint.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	tapHint.Text = "tap anywhere to skip"
	tapHint.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
	tapHint.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	tapHint.TextSize = 11
	tapHint.ZIndex = 10
	tapHint.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center

	local skipZone = Instance.new("TextButton", splashGui)
	skipZone.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
	skipZone.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	skipZone.Text = ""
	skipZone.ZIndex = 9

	local container = Instance.new("Frame", splashGui)
	container.Size = UDim2.new(0,320,0,120)
	container.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,-160,0,-140)
	container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	container.BorderSizePixel = 0
	container.ZIndex = 2
	container.ClipsDescendants = false

	local titleSplash = Instance.new("TextLabel", container)
	titleSplash.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,70)
	titleSplash.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
	titleSplash.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	titleSplash.Text = "HyperX.vs"
	titleSplash.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
	titleSplash.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	titleSplash.TextSize = 48
	titleSplash.TextTransparency = 0
	titleSplash.ZIndex = 3
	do
		local g = Instance.new("UIGradient", titleSplash)
		g.Color = ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(255,80,90)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(120,0,10))
		})
	end

	local subSplash = Instance.new("TextLabel", container)
	subSplash.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,24)
	subSplash.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,72)
	subSplash.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	subSplash.Text = "HyperX.vs"
	subSplash.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
	subSplash.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	subSplash.TextSize = 13
	subSplash.TextTransparency = 0
	subSplash.ZIndex = 3

	local fragments = {}
	local fragTexts = {"N","E","Y","H","U","B"}
	local fragColors = {
		Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255),
		Color3.fromRGB(255,70,80),
		Color3.fromRGB(220,20,35),
		Color3.fromRGB(35,35,38),
		Color3.fromRGB(180,180,185),
		Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255),
	}
	for i, txt in ipairs(fragTexts) do
		local frag = Instance.new("TextLabel", splashGui)
		frag.Size = UDim2.new(0,90,0,60)
		frag.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
		frag.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, (i-3.5)*52, 0.5, -30)
		frag.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		frag.Text = txt
		frag.TextColor3 = fragColors[i]
		frag.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		frag.TextSize = 44
		frag.TextTransparency = 1
		frag.ZIndex = 5
		frag.Rotation = 0
		table.insert(fragments, frag)
	end

	local function playSound(id, pitch, vol, parent, delay)
		task.delay(delay or 0, function()
			local s = Instance.new("Sound")
			s.SoundId = id
			s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch
			s.Volume = vol
			s.Parent = parent
			s.RollOffMaxDistance = 0
			s:Play()
			game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(s, 3)
		end)
	end

	local function playGlitchImpact()
		playSound("rbxassetid://1588058260", 1.0, 0.9, SoundService2, 0)
		playSound("rbxassetid://8627516764", 0.8, 0.7, SoundService2, 0.02)
		playSound("rbxassetid://1588058260", 1.4, 0.5, SoundService2, 0.05)
		playSound("rbxassetid://8627516764", 1.2, 0.4, SoundService2, 0.1)
	end

	local function playWhistle()
		local WHISTLE_ID = "rbxassetid://4612414100"
		playSound(WHISTLE_ID, 2.2, 0.7, SoundService2, 0)
		playSound(WHISTLE_ID, 1.7, 0.8, SoundService2, 0.07)
		playSound(WHISTLE_ID, 1.2, 0.9, SoundService2, 0.15)
		playSound(WHISTLE_ID, 0.85, 0.9, SoundService2, 0.24)
		playSound(WHISTLE_ID, 0.55, 0.7, SoundService2, 0.34)
		playSound(WHISTLE_ID, 0.3, 1.0, SoundService2, 0.5)
	end

	local function doShatterEffect()
		pcall(playGlitchImpact)
		local flash = Instance.new("Frame", splashGui)
		flash.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
		flash.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
		flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
		flash.BorderSizePixel = 0
		flash.ZIndex = 8
		TweenService2:Create(flash, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {BackgroundTransparency=1}):Play()
		game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(flash, 0.3)
		titleSplash.TextTransparency = 1
		local RunService2 = game:GetService("RunService")
		for i, frag in ipairs(fragments) do
			frag.TextTransparency = 0
			local dirX = (i - 3.5) * 60 + math.random(-80, 80)
			local dirY = math.random(120, 280)
			local rot = math.random(-180, 180)
			local startPosX = frag.Position.X.Offset
			local startPosY = frag.Position.Y.Offset
			local t = 0
			local conn
			conn = RunService2.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
				t = t + dt
				if t > 0.8 then frag.TextTransparency = 1; conn:Disconnect(); return end
				local alpha = t / 0.8
				local px = startPosX + dirX * alpha
				local py = startPosY - dirY * alpha + 300 * alpha * alpha
				local fade = math.clamp(alpha * 1.4 - 0.3, 0, 1)
				frag.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, px, 0.5, py - 30)
				frag.Rotation = rot * alpha
				frag.TextTransparency = fade
				frag.TextSize = math.clamp(44 - alpha * 20, 10, 44)
			end)
		end
		for li = 1, 8 do
			task.delay(li * 0.025, function()
				local line = Instance.new("Frame", splashGui)
				line.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.random(2,6))
				line.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, math.random(), 0)
				line.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
				line.BackgroundTransparency = math.random() * 0.3
				line.BorderSizePixel = 0
				line.ZIndex = 7
				TweenService2:Create(line, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {BackgroundTransparency=1}):Play()
				game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(line, 0.2)
			end)
		end
	end

	local splashDone = false
	local function finishSplash()
		if splashDone then return end
		splashDone = true
		TweenService2:Create(subSplash, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {TextTransparency=1}):Play()
		TweenService2:Create(overlay, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {BackgroundTransparency=1}):Play()
		tapHint.Visible = false
	end

	skipZone.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		titleSplash.TextTransparency = 1
		subSplash.TextTransparency = 1
		finishSplash()
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		TweenService2:Create(overlay, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundTransparency=0.1}):Play()
		task.wait(0.15)
		pcall(playWhistle)
		TweenService2:Create(container, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Bounce, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{Position=UDim2.new(0.5,-160,0.5,-60)}):Play()
		task.wait(0.5)
		doShatterEffect()
		task.wait(0.85)
		finishSplash()
		task.wait(0.45)
		if splashGui and splashGui.Parent then splashGui:Destroy() end
	end)

	local _t0 = tick()
	while not splashDone and (tick() - _t0) < 3.0 do
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
end

local function t(X, A, v, V, P, zN, CN)
  local bN = workspace.CurrentCamera
  local DN = bN and bN.ViewportSize or (Vector2.new(1920, 1080))
  if DN.X <= 0 or DN.Y <= 0 then
    return A, V
  end
  CN = CN or 1
  P *= CN
  zN *= CN
  local CN, bN, RN, nN = -DN.X * X, DN.X * (1 - X) - P, -DN.Y * v, DN.Y * (1 - v) - zN
  return math.clamp(A, CN, if bN < CN then CN else bN),
    math.clamp(V, RN, if nN < RN then RN else nN)
end

          and v.scrollCanvasAtStart
          and math.abs(v.scroll.CanvasPosition.Y - v.scrollCanvasAtStart) > 5
        )
      then
        v.callback()
      end
    end
  end
end))

local function V(P, zN)
  local CN = string.format(
    "%d,%d,%d",
    math.floor(P.R * 255 + 0.5),
    math.floor(P.G * 255 + 0.5),
    math.floor(P.B * 255 + 0.5)
  )
  if A[CN] then
    return A[CN]
  end
  if P.B <= P.R + 0.05 or P.B < P.G then
    return P
  end
  CN = math.max(P.R, P.G, P.B)
  if zN == "TextColor3" then
    if CN >= 0.58 then
      return Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 240)
    end
    return Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 240)
  end
  if CN >= 0.68 then
    return Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 21)
  end
  if CN >= 0.35 then
    return Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 32)
  end
  return Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 26)
end

local function DN(RN)
  if not (RN:IsA("TextLabel") or (RN:IsA("TextButton")) or (RN:IsA("TextBox"))) then
    return
  end
  if
    RN:GetAttribute("DEATHSlightFontWeightApplied")
    or (RN:GetAttribute("DEATHSlightFontWeightPending"))
  then
    return
  end
  RN:SetAttribute("DEATHSlightFontWeightPending", true)
  task.defer(function()
    if not RN.Parent or (RN:GetAttribute("DEATHSlightFontWeightApplied")) then
      RN:SetAttribute("DEATHSlightFontWeightPending", nil)
      return
    end
    local nN = pcall(function()
      local QN = RN.FontFace
      local uN = bN[QN.Weight]
      if uN then
        RN.FontFace = Font.new(QN.Family, uN, QN.Style)
      end
    end)
    RN:SetAttribute("DEATHSlightFontWeightPending", nil)
    if nN then
      RN:SetAttribute("DEATHSlightFontWeightApplied", true)
    end
  end)
end

local function nN(QN)
  local uN = QN
  while uN and not uN:IsA("GuiButton") and not uN:GetAttribute("DEATHButtonThemeControl") do
    uN = uN.Parent
  end
  if not uN then
    return
  end
  uN = QN:IsA("UIStroke") and "Color"
    or QN:IsA("UIGradient") and "Color"
    or QN:IsA("GuiObject") and "BackgroundColor3"
  if not uN then
    return
  end
  local pN = RN[QN]
  if not pN then
    pN = {}
    RN[QN] = pN
    _G.__DEATHTrackConn(QN:GetPropertyChangedSignal(uN):Connect(function()
      nN(QN)
    end))
  end
  if pN.busy then
    return
  end
  local RN = QN[uN]
  if RN == pN.applied and pN.theme == _G.__DEATHGuiTheme then
    return
  end
  if RN ~= pN.applied then
    pN.original = RN
  end
  local oN = _G.__DEATHGuiTheme
  local function _N(UN)
    if oN ~= "GUI 2" and oN ~= "GUI 3" then
      return UN
    end
    local yN = math.max(UN.R, UN.G, UN.B)
    return Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 17):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 36), yN)
  end
  local UN = pN.original
  if QN:IsA("UIGradient") then
    if oN == "GUI 2" or oN == "GUI 3" then
      local yN = {}
      for HN, HN in ipairs(UN.Keypoints) do
        table.insert(yN, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(HN.Time, _N(HN.Value)))
      end
      UN = (ColorSequence.new(yN))
    end
  else
    UN = (_N(UN))
  end
  pN.applied = UN
  pN.theme = oN
  if RN ~= UN then
    pN.busy = true
    QN[uN] = UN
    pN.busy = false
  end
end
bN = function(RN)
  if not RN then
    return
  end
  local QN
  if RN:IsA("TextLabel") or (RN:IsA("TextButton")) or (RN:IsA("TextBox")) then
    DN(RN)
    QN = zN
  else
    QN = if RN:IsA("GuiObject") then P else QN
  end
  if QN then
    for zN, uN in ipairs(QN) do
      zN = RN[uN]
      string.format(
        "%d,%d,%d",
        math.floor(zN.R * 255 + 0.5),
        math.floor(zN.G * 255 + 0.5),
        math.floor(zN.B * 255 + 0.5)
      )
      local pN = V(zN, uN)
      if pN ~= zN then
        RN[uN] = pN
      end
    end
  end
  if RN:IsA("UIStroke") then
    QN = RN.Color
    local V = string.format(
      "%d,%d,%d",
      math.floor(QN.R * 255 + 0.5),
      math.floor(QN.G * 255 + 0.5),
      math.floor(QN.B * 255 + 0.5)
    )
    if QN.B > QN.R + 0.05 and QN.B >= QN.G then
      RN.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 225)
    elseif A[V] then
      RN.Color = A[V]
    end
  end
  if not _G.__DEATHModernGuiActive and not RN:GetAttribute("DEATHDarkPaletteWatched") then
    RN:SetAttribute("DEATHDarkPaletteWatched", true)
    local function A(V)
      _G.__DEATHTrackConn(RN:GetPropertyChangedSignal(V):Connect(function()
        bN(RN)
      end))
    end
    if RN:IsA("UIStroke") then
      A("Color")
    elseif RN:IsA("GuiObject") then
      for V, V in ipairs(P) do
        A(V)
      end
      if RN:IsA("TextLabel") or (RN:IsA("TextButton")) or (RN:IsA("TextBox")) then
        for V, V in ipairs(CN) do
          A(V)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  nN(RN)
end

    end)
  else
    if _G.__openBypassGUI then
      _G.__openBypassGUI()
    end
    task.spawn(function()
      for nN = 1, 20, 1 do
        task.wait(0.1)
        if _G.DEATHBypass and _G.DEATHBypass.SetBypass and _G.DEATHBypass.IsEnabled then
          break
        end
      end
      if _G.DEATHBypass and _G.DEATHBypass.SetBypass and _G.DEATHBypass.IsEnabled then
        local nN = _G.DEATHBypass.IsEnabled() == true
        pcall(_G.DEATHBypass.SetBypass, not nN)
      end
      pcall(function()
        if _G.__syncBypassVisual then
          _G.__syncBypassVisual()
        end
      end)
    end)
  end
end

      end
      if T[UN] then

      pN = true
    end
  end
  if pN then
    oN()
  end
end

-- HyperX.vs: fundo embutido no proprio TXT (nao precisa colocar a imagem numa pasta)
do
  local _death_b64 = ""
  local function _death_b64decode(data)
    local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
    data = data:gsub("[^" .. alphabet .. "=]", "")
    return (data:gsub("....?", function(block)
      if #block < 4 then return "" end
      local a = alphabet:find(block:sub(1,1), 1, true) - 1
      local b = alphabet:find(block:sub(2,2), 1, true) - 1
      local c = block:sub(3,3) == "=" and 0 or (alphabet:find(block:sub(3,3), 1, true) - 1)
      local d = block:sub(4,4) == "=" and 0 or (alphabet:find(block:sub(4,4), 1, true) - 1)
      local n = a * 262144 + b * 4096 + c * 64 + d
      local out = string.char(math.floor(n / 65536) % 256, math.floor(n / 256) % 256)
      if block:sub(3,3) ~= "=" then out = out .. string.char(n % 256) end
      return out
    end))
  end
  pcall(function()
    if typeof(writefile) == "function" then
      pcall(function()
        writefile("HyperXvs_background.jpg", _death_b64decode(_death_b64))
      end)
    end
  end)
end

do
  local aN, hN
  local fN, JN = false
  local function LN(ON)
    pcall(function()
      if _G.__DEATHPreserveOptimizerUI(ON) then
        return
      end
      local iN, SN = pcall(function()
        return ON:IsDescendantOf(game:GetService("Lighting"))
      end)
      if iN and SN then
        return
      end
      if
        ON:IsA("Sky")
        or (ON:IsA("Atmosphere"))
        or (ON:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect"))
        or (ON:IsA("BloomEffect"))
        or (ON:IsA("BlurEffect"))
        or (ON:IsA("SunRaysEffect"))
        or (ON:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect"))
      then
        return
      end
      iN, SN = pcall(function()
        local ZN = ON
        while ZN and ZN ~= workspace do
          if ZN.Name == "Headless_Headless" or (ZN.Name:find("^Korblox_")) then
            return true
          end
          ZN = ZN.Parent
        end
        return false
      end)
      if iN and SN then
        return
      end
      if ON:IsA("Accessory") or (ON:IsA("Hat")) then
        ON:Destroy()
      elseif
        ON:IsA("Shirt")
        or (ON:IsA("Pants"))
        or (ON:IsA("ShirtGraphic"))
        or (ON:IsA("BodyColors"))
        or (ON:IsA("CharacterMesh"))
      then
        ON:Destroy()
      elseif ON:IsA("BasePart") then
        ON.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
        ON.Reflectance = 0
        ON.CastShadow = false
      elseif ON:IsA("Decal") or (ON:IsA("Texture")) then
        ON.Transparency = 1
      elseif
        ON:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
        or (ON:IsA("Trail"))
        or (ON:IsA("Beam"))
        or (ON:IsA("Fire"))
        or (ON:IsA("Smoke"))
        or (ON:IsA("Sparkles"))
      then
        ON.Enabled = false
      elseif ON:IsA("AnimationController") or (ON:IsA("Animator")) then
        iN = ON.Parent
        while iN and iN ~= workspace do
          if iN:IsA("Model") and (z:GetPlayerFromCharacter(iN)) then
            return
          end
          iN = iN.Parent
        end
        for iN, iN in ipairs(ON:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
          pcall(function()
            iN:Stop(0)
          end)
        end
      end
    end)
  end
  local function ON()
    if JN then
      JN()
    end
    JN = _G.__DEATHWalkDescendantsBatched(workspace, LN, function()
      return fN
    end)
  end
  local function iN()
    if fN then
      return
    end
    fN = true
    if aN then
      aN:Disconnect()
    end
    aN = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(SN)
      if fN then
        LN(SN)
      end
    end)

      hN:Disconnect()

        _G.__DEATHWalkDescendantsBatched(ON, LN, function()

  end
  local function LN()
    if not fN then

    end

    if JN then
      JN()

    end

      aN:Disconnect()

    end
    if hN then

(function()
  local aN, hN, fN, JN, LN, ON, iN =
    false,
    0,
    {},
    setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
    {},
    setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
    setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
  local SN
  local function ZN(YN, jN, eN)
    pcall(function()
      local qN = YN[jN]
      if qN == eN then
        return
      end
      YN[jN] = eN
      local eN = JN[YN]
      if not eN then
        eN = {}
        JN[YN] = eN
      end
      if not eN[jN] then
        eN[jN] = { value = qN }
      end
    end)
  end
  local function YN(jN)
    local eN = u.Character
    if eN and (jN == eN or (jN:IsDescendantOf(eN))) then
      return true
    end
    eN = jN
    while eN and eN ~= workspace do
      if eN:IsA("LayerCollector") or (eN:IsA("GuiObject")) or (eN:IsA("GuiBase2d")) then
        return true
      end
      local qN = eN.Name or ""
      if
        qN:match("^DEATH")
        or (qN:match("^__DEATH"))
        or (qN:match("^DEATH"))
        or (qN:match("^ESP_"))
        or (qN:match("^SkinChanger_"))
        or (qN:match("^Korblox_"))
        or qN == "Headless_Headless"
        or qN == "GreenDuelsBB"
        or qN == "PredictionSphere"
      then
        return true
      end
      eN = eN.Parent
    end
    if y["Sky Changer"] and (jN == n or (jN:IsDescendantOf(n))) then
      return true
    end
    return false
  end
  local function jN(eN)
    if ON[eN] then
      return
    end
    local qN = u.Character
    if qN and (eN:IsDescendantOf(qN)) then
      return
    end
    ON[eN] = true
    local qN = hN
    local KN, GN = pcall(function()
      return eN.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(IN)
        if not aN or hN ~= qN then
          return
        end
        task.defer(function()
          if aN and hN == qN then
            pcall(function()
              IN:Stop(0)
            end)
          end
        end)
      end)
    end)
    if KN then
      table.insert(fN, GN)
    end
    pcall(function()
      for qN, qN in ipairs(eN:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
        if qN.IsPlaying then
          iN[qN] = { animator = eN, time = qN.TimePosition, speed = qN.Speed }
          qN:Stop(0)
        end
      end
    end)
  end
  local function eN(qN)
    if not aN or (YN(qN)) then
      return
    end
    if qN:IsA("Terrain") then
      ZN(qN, "Decoration", false)
      ZN(qN, "WaterWaveSize", 0)
      ZN(qN, "WaterWaveSpeed", 0)
      ZN(qN, "WaterReflectance", 0)
      ZN(qN, "WaterTransparency", 1)
    end
    if qN:IsA("BasePart") then
      ZN(qN, "Material", Enum.Material.Plastic)
      ZN(qN, "MaterialVariant", "")
      ZN(qN, "Reflectance", 0)
      ZN(qN, "CastShadow", false)
      if qN:IsA("MeshPart") then
        ZN(qN, "TextureID", "")
        ZN(qN, "RenderFidelity", Enum.RenderFidelity.Performance)
        ZN(qN, "DoubleSided", false)
      elseif qN:IsA("PartOperation") then
        ZN(qN, "RenderFidelity", Enum.RenderFidelity.Performance)
      end
    elseif qN:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
      ZN(qN, "TextureId", "")
    elseif qN:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
      LN[qN] = true
      ZN(qN, "Parent", nil)
    elseif qN:IsA("Decal") or (qN:IsA("Texture")) then

    if not YN then
      return

    iN.velChecked[YN] = true
    if iN.hooked then
      return
    end
    if
      type(getrawmetatable) ~= "function"
      or type(setreadonly) ~= "function"
      or type(newcclosure) ~= "function"
      or type(checkcaller) ~= "function"
    then
      return
    end
    pcall(function()
      local YN = getrawmetatable(game)
      if not YN then
        return
      end
      local jN = rawget(YN, "__index")
      if type(jN) ~= "function" and type(jN) ~= "table" then
        return
      end
      local eN = newcclosure(function(qN, KN)
        local GN = if type(jN) == "function" then (jN(qN, KN)) else jN[KN]
        if
          not checkcaller()
          and iN.velChecked[qN]
          and (KN == "AssemblyLinearVelocity" or KN == "Velocity")
          and typeof(GN) == "Vector3"
          and GN.Magnitude > 20
        then
          return GN.Unit * 20
        end
        return GN
      end)
      setreadonly(YN, false)
      YN.__index = eN
      iN.hooked = true
      setreadonly(YN, true)
    end)
  end

          task.wait()
        end
      end
      if I then
        I()
      end
      F()
    else
      if I then
        I()
      end
      F()
    end
  end

  local function R(mN)
    if typeof(mN) == "table" then
      return mN
    end
    local sN = {}
    for MN in string.gmatch(tostring(mN), "[^%.]+") do
      table.insert(sN, tonumber(MN) or MN)
    end
    return sN
  end
  local function mN(sN, MN)
    local dN, cN, TN = MN
    for MN, MN in ipairs(R(sN)) do
      dN, cN, TN = dN and dN[MN] or nil, dN, MN
    end
    return dN, cN, TN
  end
  local function R(sN, MN)
    local dN = SN.caches[sN]
    if typeof(dN) ~= "table" then
      return
    end
    local sN, cN, TN, WN = MN[1], MN[2], MN[3], MN[4]
    local MN, wN, rN = mN(sN, dN)
    if cN == "Changed" then
      if wN ~= nil then
        wN[rN] = TN
      end
    elseif cN == "ArrayInsert" then
      if MN ~= nil then
        table.insert(MN, WN, TN)
      end
    elseif cN == "ArrayRemoved" then
      if MN ~= nil then
        table.remove(MN, WN)
      end
    elseif cN == "DictionaryInsert" then
      if MN ~= nil then
        MN[WN] = TN
      end
    elseif cN == "DictionaryRemoved" then
      if MN ~= nil then
        MN[WN] = nil
      end
    end
  end
  local function mN(sN)
    if not iN or SN.connections[sN] then
      return
    end
    local MN = tostring(sN.Name)
    if not LN:FindFirstChild(MN) then
      return
    end
    if iN.requestData and SN.caches[MN] == nil then
      local dN, cN = pcall(function()
        return iN.requestData:InvokeServer(MN)
      end)
      SN.caches[MN] = dN and typeof(cN) == "table" and cN or {}
    elseif SN.caches[MN] == nil then
      SN.caches[MN] = {}
    end
    SN.connections[sN] = sN.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(sN)
      for dN, dN in ipairs(sN) do
        R(MN, dN)
      end
    end)
  end

        SN.caches[tostring(sN)] = nil
        break
      end
    end
  end

  local function R(ON)
    if YN[ON] then
      return
    end

    if getconnections then
      eN, lN = pcall(getconnections, ON.PromptButtonHoldBegan)
    end
    if eN and type(lN) == "table" then
      for mN, mN in ipairs(lN) do

          table.insert(ZN.holdCallbacks, mN.Function)
        end
      end
    end
    lN, eN = false
    if getconnections then
      lN, eN = pcall(getconnections, ON.Triggered)
    end
    if lN and type(eN) == "table" then
      for lN, lN in ipairs(eN) do
        if type(lN.Function) == "function" then
          table.insert(ZN.triggerCallbacks, lN.Function)
        end
      end
    end
    if #ZN.holdCallbacks > 0 or #ZN.triggerCallbacks > 0 then
      YN[ON] = ZN
    end
  end
  local function ON(ZN, eN)
    local lN = YN[ZN]
    if not lN or not lN.ready then
      return false
    end
    lN.ready = false
    local mN = eN and eN.name or "Animal"
    kN.active = true
    kN.startTime = tick()
    kN.phase = "holding"
    kN.label = mN
    NN(false)
    I = 0

    task.spawn(function()
      FN.HOLD_MIN = O.Duration or FN.HOLD_MIN
      FN.HOLD_MAX = FN.HOLD_MIN + 1.3
      for dN, dN in ipairs(lN.holdCallbacks) do
        task.spawn(dN)
      end
      while tick() - kN.startTime < FN.HOLD_MIN do
        if MN ~= IN then
          lN.ready = true
          return
        end
        if not FN.AUTO_STEAL_ENABLED or not ZN.Parent then
          break
        end
        local dN = tick() - kN.startTime
        I = math.clamp(dN / FN.HOLD_MAX, 0, 1)
        task.wait(0.05)
      end
      kN.phase = "waitingRange"
      local dN, cN = eN and SN(eN) <= FN.STEAL_RANGE, false
      while MN == IN and FN.AUTO_STEAL_ENABLED and ZN.Parent do
        local ZN = tick() - kN.startTime
        I = math.clamp(ZN / FN.HOLD_MAX, 0, 1)
        if ZN > FN.HOLD_MAX then
          break
        end
        if eN and SN(eN) <= FN.STEAL_RANGE then
          if not dN then
            task.wait(FN.ENTRY_DELAY)
          end
          for SN, SN in ipairs(lN.triggerCallbacks) do
            task.spawn(SN)
          end
          cN = true
          break
        end
        task.wait(0.05)
      end
      if MN ~= IN then
        lN.ready = true
        return
      end
      if cN then
        kN.totalSteals = kN.totalSteals + 1
        kN.lastResult = "Stole " .. mN
        kN.phase = "success"
        NN(true)
      else
        kN.failedSteals = kN.failedSteals + 1
        kN.lastResult = "Missed window: " .. mN
        kN.phase = "failed"
      end
      kN.active = false
      kN.lastResultTime = tick()
      I = 1
      task.wait(FN.COOLDOWN)
      I = 0
      lN.ready = true
    end)
    return true
  end

      and (
        lN:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        or (lN:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"))
        or (lN:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
      )
    if not MN then
      return nil
    end
    local dN, cN, TN = math.huge, mN * mN
    for WN, wN in ipairs(LN:GetChildren()) do
      WN = wN:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
      lN = WN and (WN:FindFirstChild("YourBase"))
      if wN:IsA("Model") and not (lN and (lN:IsA("BillboardGui")) and lN.Enabled) then
        WN = wN:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
        if WN then
          for lN, wN in ipairs(WN:GetChildren()) do
            lN = wN:FindFirstChild("Base") and (wN.Base:FindFirstChild("Spawn"))
            if lN then
              wN = lN.Position - MN.Position
              local MN = wN:Dot(wN)
              if MN <= cN and MN < dN then
                local cN = EN(lN)
                if cN then
                  dN, TN = MN, cN
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    ZN.prompt = TN
    ZN.radius = mN
    ZN.expiresAt = tick() + 0.12
    return TN
  end
  function _G.__DEATHAutoGrabTargetInRadius(ZN)
    return eN(ZN or 65) ~= nil
  end
  local function ZN(EN)
    local lN = u.Character
    local mN = lN
      and (
        lN:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        or (lN:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"))
        or (lN:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
      )
    if not mN then
      return math.huge
    end
    lN = EN.Parent
    lN = if lN and (lN:IsA("Attachment")) then lN.Parent else lN
    if lN and (lN:IsA("BasePart")) then
      return (lN.Position - mN.Position).Magnitude
    end
    local lN, MN = pcall(function()
      return EN.Parent and EN.Parent.WorldPosition
    end)
    if lN and MN then
      return (MN - mN.Position).Magnitude
    end
    return math.huge
  end
  local function EN(lN)
    local mN = R.data[lN]
    if mN then
      return mN
    end
    mN = { hold = {}, trigger = {}, ready = true }
    if getconnections then
      for MN, MN in ipairs(getconnections(lN.PromptButtonHoldBegan)) do
        if MN.Function then
          table.insert(mN.hold, MN.Function)
        end
      end
      for MN, MN in ipairs(getconnections(lN.Triggered)) do
        if MN.Function then
          table.insert(mN.trigger, MN.Function)
        end
      end
    end
    R.data[lN] = mN
    return mN
  end
  local function lN(mN, MN)
    if not mN or not mN.Parent then
      return false
    end
    if u:GetAttribute("Stealing") == true then
      return false
    end
    local dN = false
    for cN, cN in ipairs(MN.trigger) do
      dN = if pcall(cN) then true else dN
    end
    dN = if not dN
        and u:GetAttribute("Stealing") ~= true
        and typeof(fireproximityprompt) == "function"
      then pcall(fireproximityprompt, mN) or dN
      else dN
    return if not dN and u:GetAttribute("Stealing") ~= true
      then (pcall(function()
        mN:InputHoldBegin()
        task.wait(0.05)
        mN:InputHoldEnd()
      end))
      else dN
  end
  local function mN(MN)
    if R.busy or not MN or not MN.Parent then
      return
    end
    if u:GetAttribute("Stealing") == true then
      return
    end
    local dN = EN(MN)
    if #dN.trigger == 0 then
      R.data[MN] = nil
      dN = EN(MN)
    end
    if not dN.ready then
      return
    end
    dN.ready = false
    R.busy = true
    R.active = true
    R.isStealing = true
    R.startTime = tick()
    R.progress = 0
    R.phase = "holding"
    R.generation = R.generation + 1
    local EN = R.generation
    NN(true)
    task.spawn(function()
      for cN, cN in ipairs(dN.hold) do
        task.spawn(cN)
      end
      local cN = tick()
      while R.busy and tick() - cN < ON.HOLD_MIN do
        if EN ~= R.generation then
          return
        end
        R.progress = math.clamp((tick() - cN) / ON.HOLD_MIN, 0, 1)
        I = R.progress
        task.wait(0.05)
      end
      if EN ~= R.generation then
        return
      end
      R.progress = 1
      I = 1
      R.phase = "waiting"
      local TN, WN = ZN(MN) <= ON.FIRE_RANGE, false
      while
        EN == R.generation
        and MN.Parent
        and FN.AUTO_STEAL_ENABLED
        and u:GetAttribute("Stealing") ~= true
      do
        R.progress = 1
        I = 1
        local wN = ZN(MN)
        if wN > ON.NEAR_TARGET_RANGE and tick() - cN > ON.HOLD_MAX then
          break
        end
        if wN <= ON.FIRE_RANGE then
          if not TN then
            task.wait(ON.ENTRY_DELAY)
            if EN ~= R.generation or not MN.Parent or ZN(MN) > ON.FIRE_RANGE then
              task.wait(0.05)
              continue
            end
          end
          R.phase = "triggering"
          if not lN(MN, dN) then
            R.phase = "waiting"
            task.wait(0.05)
            continue
          end
          R.totalSteals = R.totalSteals + 1
          kN.totalSteals = kN.totalSteals + 1
          R.lastResult = "[OK] ROBADO!"
          kN.lastResult = "Stole"
          R.isStealing = true
          R.phase = "success"
          WN = true
          break
        end
        task.wait(0.05)
      end
      if EN ~= R.generation then
        return
      end
      R.active = false
      R.isStealing = false
      R.busy = false
      dN.ready = true
      NN(false)
      if not WN then
        R.failedSteals = R.failedSteals + 1
        R.lastResult = "[X] FALLO"
        R.phase = "failed"
      end
      R.lastResultTime = tick()
      kN.lastResultTime = tick()
      task.wait(ON.COOLDOWN)
      if EN ~= R.generation then
        return
      end
      R.progress = 0
      I = 0
      R.phase = "idle"
    end)
  end
  local ON, EN =
    {
      busy = false,
      active = false,
      progress = 0,
      paused = false,
      pauseTime = nil,
      totalSteals = 0,
      failedSteals = 0,
      lastResult = "",
      generation = 0,
      phase = "idle",
      data = {},
    }, { STEAL_DURATION = 1.3, HOLD_TARGET = 0.8, TRIGGER_RADIUS = 10, PAUSE_TIMEOUT = 1.3, COOLDOWN = 0.05 }
  local function lN(MN)
    local dN = ON.data[MN]
    if dN then
      return dN
    end
    dN = { hold = {}, trigger = {}, ready = true }
    if getconnections then
      pcall(function()
        for cN, cN in ipairs(getconnections(MN.PromptButtonHoldBegan)) do
          if cN.Function then
            table.insert(dN.hold, cN.Function)
          end
        end
        for cN, cN in ipairs(getconnections(MN.Triggered)) do
          if cN.Function then
            table.insert(dN.trigger, cN.Function)
          end
        end
      end)
    end
    ON.data[MN] = dN
    return dN
  end
  local function MN(dN)
    if ON.busy or not dN or not dN.Parent then
      return
    end
    if u:GetAttribute("Stealing") == true then
      return
    end
    local cN = lN(dN)
    if not cN.ready then
      return
    end
    cN.ready = false
    ON.busy = true
    ON.active = true
    ON.progress = 0
    ON.paused = false
    ON.pauseTime = nil
    ON.phase = "holding"
    ON.generation = ON.generation + 1
    local lN, TN, WN, wN = ON.generation, tick(), true, false
    kN.active = true
    kN.startTime = TN
    kN.phase = "holding"
    I = 0
    NN(true)
    task.spawn(function()
      for rN, rN in ipairs(cN.hold) do
        task.spawn(function()
          pcall(rN)
        end)
      end
      while
        lN == ON.generation
        and FN.AUTO_STEAL_ENABLED
        and i == "v2"
        and u:GetAttribute("Stealing") ~= true
        and dN.Parent
      do
        if ON.paused then
          if ZN(dN) <= EN.TRIGGER_RADIUS then
            ON.paused = false
            ON.pauseTime = nil
            ON.phase = "finishing"
            TN = tick() - EN.HOLD_TARGET * EN.STEAL_DURATION
          else
            if not ON.pauseTime then
              ON.pauseTime = tick()
            elseif tick() - ON.pauseTime >= EN.PAUSE_TIMEOUT then
              break
            end
            ON.progress = EN.HOLD_TARGET
            I = ON.progress
            kN.label = "80%"
            task.wait(0.05)
            continue
          end
        end
        local ZN = math.clamp((tick() - TN) / EN.STEAL_DURATION, 0, 1)
        ON.progress = ZN
        I = ZN
        kN.label = math.floor(ZN * 100 + 0.5) .. "%"
        if WN and ZN >= EN.HOLD_TARGET then
          WN = false
          ON.paused = true
          ON.pauseTime = tick()
          ON.progress = EN.HOLD_TARGET
          I = ON.progress
          ON.phase = "waitingRange"
          kN.phase = "waitingRange"
        elseif ZN >= 1 then
          ON.phase = "triggering"
          for ZN, ZN in ipairs(cN.trigger) do
            task.spawn(function()
              pcall(ZN)
            end)
          end
          wN = true
          break
        end
        task.wait(0.05)
      end
      if lN ~= ON.generation then
        return
      end
      ON.active = false
      ON.busy = false
      ON.paused = false
      ON.pauseTime = nil
      cN.ready = true
      kN.active = false
      kN.lastResultTime = tick()
      NN(false)
      if wN then
        ON.totalSteals = ON.totalSteals + 1
        ON.lastResult = "Stole"
        ON.phase = "success"
        kN.totalSteals = kN.totalSteals + 1
        kN.lastResult = "Stole"
      else
        ON.failedSteals = ON.failedSteals + 1
        ON.lastResult = "Missed window"
        ON.phase = "failed"
        kN.failedSteals = kN.failedSteals + 1
        kN.lastResult = "Missed window"
      end
      task.wait(EN.COOLDOWN)
      if lN == ON.generation then
        ON.progress = 0
        I = 0
        ON.phase = "idle"
      end
    end)
  end
  local function ZN()
    if jN then
      return
    end
    local EN = 0
    jN = D.Heartbeat:Connect(function(lN)
      EN += lN or 0
      if EN < 0.15 then
        return
      end
      EN = 0
      if not FN.AUTO_STEAL_ENABLED then
        return
      end
      if u:GetAttribute("Stealing") == true then
        return
      end
      if _G.__DEATHAutoGrabRagdollBlocked == true then
        return
      end
      if kN.active or F.busy or R.busy or ON.busy then
        return
      end
      if i == "v2" then
        lN = eN(O.Radius)
        if lN then
          MN(lN)
        end
        return
      end
      if i == "v1" then
        lN = eN(O.Radius)
        if lN then
          mN(lN)
        end
        return
      end
    end)
  end
  function _G.DEATHAutoStealRunCycle(eN, EN)
    return SN(eN, EN)
  end
  local function SN()
    if KN then
      for eN, eN in ipairs(KN) do
        pcall(function()
          eN:Disconnect()
        end)
      end
    end
    KN = {}
    if GN then
      task.cancel(GN)
      GN = nil
    end
  end
  local function eN(EN)
    SN()
    local SN = EN and (EN:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
    if not SN then
      return
    end
    table.insert(
      KN,
      SN:GetPropertyChangedSignal("WalkSpeed"):Connect(function()
        NN(SN.WalkSpeed < 22)
      end)
    )
    local function SN(lN)
      if not lN:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
        return
      end
      table.insert(
        KN,
        lN.PromptButtonHoldBegan:Connect(function(mN)
          if mN ~= k then
            return
          end
          NN(true)
          if GN then
            task.cancel(GN)
          end
          GN = task.delay(FN.HOLD_MAX + 0.5, function()
            NN(false)
          end)
        end)
      )
      table.insert(
        KN,
        lN.Triggered:Connect(function(GN)
          if GN ~= k then
            return
          end
          task.delay(0.2, function()
            NN(false)
          end)
        end)
      )
    end
    table.insert(
      KN,
      workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(k)
        task.defer(SN, k)
      end)
    )
    _G.__DEATHWalkDescendantsBatched(LN, SN, function()
      return EN.Parent ~= nil
    end)
  end
  local function k()
    if qN then
      return
    end
    qN = true
    task.spawn(function()
      if sN() then
        if FN.AUTO_STEAL_ENABLED then
          iN()
        end
        while o.alive do
          task.wait(5)
          if not o.alive then
            break
          end
          if FN.AUTO_STEAL_ENABLED then
            iN()
          end
        end
      end
    end)
  end
  k()
  if u.Character then
    task.defer(eN, u.Character)
  end
  _G.__DEATHTrackConn(u.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(LN)
    task.wait(0.5)
    eN(LN)
    if y["auto steal"] then
      FN.AUTO_STEAL_ENABLED = false
      if jN then
        jN:Disconnect()
        jN = nil
      end
      FN.AUTO_STEAL_ENABLED = true
      iN()
      ZN()
    end
  end))
  _G.DEATHAutoGrab = {
    GetMode = function()
      return i
    end,
    SetMode = function(LN)
      if LN ~= "v1" and LN ~= "v2" then
        return false
      end
      i = LN
      oN()
      return true
    end,
  }
  local function LN()
    k()
    iN()
    FN.AUTO_STEAL_ENABLED = true
    ZN()
  end
  local function k()
    IN += 1
    if jN then
      jN:Disconnect()
      jN = nil
    end
    FN.AUTO_STEAL_ENABLED = false
    kN.active = false
    kN.phase = "idle"
    NN(false)
    I, YN = 0, {}
    F.busy = false
    F.data = {}
    if R then
      R.generation = R.generation + 1
      R.busy = false
      R.active = false
      R.isStealing = false
      R.progress = 0
      R.phase = "idle"
      R.data = {}
    end
    if ON then
      ON.generation = ON.generation + 1
      ON.busy = false
      ON.active = false
      ON.paused = false
      ON.pauseTime = nil
      ON.progress = 0
      ON.phase = "idle"
      ON.data = {}
    end
  end
  autoStealDisableInternal = k
  _G.__DEATHTrackConn(u.CharacterRemoving:Connect(k))
  _G.__DEATHTrackStopper(k);
  (function()
    local R, ON, iN, SN = 0
    local ZN, YN, jN = false, false, 0
    local function eN(qN, KN)
      return qN.PlatformStand
        or KN == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
        or KN == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
        or KN == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
    end
    local function qN(KN)
      if not KN then
        return false
      end
      for GN, IN in ipairs(KN:GetDescendants()) do
        if not IN:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool") then
          GN = IN.Name:lower()
          if
            GN:find("medusa")
            or (GN:find("petrif"))
            or (GN:find("gorgon"))
            or (GN:find("stone"))
          then
            return true
          end
          for KN, GN in pairs(IN:GetAttributes()) do
            local IN = tostring(KN):lower()
            if
              GN
              and (
                IN:find("medusa")
                or (IN:find("petrif"))
                or (IN:find("gorgon"))
                or (IN:find("stone"))
              )
            then
              return true
            end
          end
        end
      end
      return false
    end
    local function KN(GN)
      R += 1
      local GN = R
      _G.__DEATHAutoGrabRagdollBlocked = true
      YN = true
      k()
      task.delay(1, function()
        if GN ~= R then
          return
        end
        YN = false
        if not y["auto steal"] then
          return
        end
        _G.__DEATHAutoGrabRagdollBlocked = false
        if not FN.AUTO_STEAL_ENABLED then
          LN()
        end
        pcall(function()
          if
            _G.DEATHBypass
            and _G.DEATHBypass.IsAutoOnSteal
            and (_G.DEATHBypass.IsAutoOnSteal())
            and _G.DEATHBypass.SetAutoOnSteal
          then
            pcall(_G.DEATHBypass.SetAutoOnSteal, true)
          end
        end)
      end)
    end
    local function GN(IN)
      if ON then
        ON:Disconnect()
        ON = nil
      end
      if iN then
        iN:Disconnect()
        iN = nil
      end
      if SN then
        SN:Disconnect()
        SN = nil
      end
      ZN, jN = false, 0
      local kN = IN and (IN:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or (IN:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)))
      if not kN then
        return
      end
      local EN = qN
      if EN(IN) then
        jN = tick() + 5
      end
      SN = IN.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(SN)
        if SN:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool") then
          return
        end
        local EN = SN.Name:lower()
        SN = EN:find("medusa") or (EN:find("petrif")) or (EN:find("gorgon")) or (EN:find("stone"))
        if SN then
          jN = tick() + 5
        end
      end)
      local function SN(EN)
        local lN = qN
        if lN(IN) then
          jN = tick() + 5
        end
        lN = eN(kN, EN)
        if lN and not ZN then
          ZN = true
          KN(tick() <= jN)
        elseif not lN then
          ZN = false
          if not YN then
            _G.__DEATHAutoGrabRagdollBlocked = false
            if y["auto steal"] and not FN.AUTO_STEAL_ENABLED then
              LN()
            end
          end
        end
      end
      ON = kN.StateChanged:Connect(function(ON, ON)
        SN(ON)
      end)
      iN = kN:GetPropertyChangedSignal("PlatformStand"):Connect(function()
        SN(kN:GetState())
      end)
    end
    if u.Character then
      task.defer(GN, u.Character)
    end
    _G.__DEATHTrackConn(u.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ON)
      R += 1
      YN = false
      _G.__DEATHAutoGrabRagdollBlocked = false
      GN(ON)
    end))
  end)()
  T["auto steal"] = function(R)
    if R then
      if _G.__DEATHAutoGrabRagdollBlocked ~= true then
        LN()
      end
    else
      k()
    end
  end
  if y["auto steal"] then
    LN()
  end
end
do
  do
    local function R(k, LN)
      if y[k] == LN then
        return
      end
      y[k] = LN
      if T[k] then
        T[k](LN)
      end
      if M[k] then
        M[k]()
      end
      oN()
    end
    local function k()
      R("Autoplay", false)
    end
    local function R(LN)
      if not LN then
        return
      end
      local ON = os.clock()
      if _G._DEATHHitCountdownLast and ON - _G._DEATHHitCountdownLast < 0.15 then
        return
      end
      _G._DEATHHitCountdownLast = ON
      local iN = (_G._DEATHHitCountdownGen or 0) + 1
      _G._DEATHHitCountdownGen = iN
      _G._DEATHHitCountdownActive = true
      if _G._DEATHHitCountdownBB then
        pcall(function()
          _G._DEATHHitCountdownBB:Destroy()
        end)
        _G._DEATHHitCountdownBB = nil
      end
      pcall(function()
        _G._DEATHShowStealCountdown = R
      end)
      ON = LN:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
        or (LN:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
        or (LN:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"))
        or (LN:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
      if not ON then
        _G._DEATHHitCountdownActive = false
        return
      end
      local SN = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
      SN.Name = "DEATHHitCountdown"
      SN.Adornee = ON
      SN.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 56)
      SN.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)
      SN.AlwaysOnTop = true
      SN.LightInfluence = 0
      SN.Parent = u and (u:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or (game:GetService("CoreGui")))
        or (game:GetService("CoreGui"))
      _G._DEATHHitCountdownBB = SN
      LN = Instance.new("Frame", SN)
      LN.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
      LN.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      LN.BorderSizePixel = 0
      local ON = Instance.new("TextLabel", LN)
      ON.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
      ON.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 6)
      ON.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      ON.Text = "3"
      ON.TextScaled = false
      ON.TextSize = 28
      ON.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
      ON.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(175, 180, 185)
      ON.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
      ON.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
      ON.ZIndex = 10
      ON.TextTransparency = 1
      local function LN(ZN, YN)
        ON.Text = ZN
        if YN then
          ON.TextColor3 = YN
        end
        YN = ZN == "STEAL!" and 1 or 0.76
        for ZN = 0, 6, 1 do
          ON.TextTransparency = 1 - ZN / 6
          task.wait(0.02)
          if _G._DEATHHitCountdownGen ~= iN then
            return false
          end
        end
        task.wait(YN)
        if _G._DEATHHitCountdownGen ~= iN then
          return false
        end
        for ZN = 0, 6, 1 do
          ON.TextTransparency = ZN / 6
          task.wait(0.02)
          if _G._DEATHHitCountdownGen ~= iN then
            return false
          end
        end
        return true
      end
      task.spawn(function()
        pcall(function()
          ON.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
          ON.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(175, 180, 185)
          for ZN = 0, 24, 1 do
            local YN = 2.4 - 2.4 * ZN / 24
            ON.Text = YN <= 0.05 and "0" or (string.format("%.1f", YN))
            ON.TextTransparency = 0
            for ZN = 0, 2, 1 do
              ON.TextTransparency = 0.18 * ZN
              task.wait(0.02)
              if _G._DEATHHitCountdownGen ~= iN then
                return
              end
            end
            if _G._DEATHHitCountdownGen ~= iN then
              return
            end
            task.wait(0.08)
            if _G._DEATHHitCountdownGen ~= iN then
              return
            end
          end
          if not LN("STEAL!", Color3.fromRGB(175, 180, 185)) then
            return
          end
        end)
        if _G._DEATHHitCountdownGen == iN then
          pcall(function()
            SN:Destroy()
          end)
          if _G._DEATHHitCountdownBB == SN then
            _G._DEATHHitCountdownBB = nil
          end
          _G._DEATHHitCountdownActive = false
        end
      end)
    end
    local function LN(ON)
      local iN = ON:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if not iN then
        return
      end
      local SN = iN.Health
      iN.HealthChanged:Connect(function(ZN)
        if ZN < SN then
          k()
          pcall(function()
            R(ON)
          end)
        end
        SN = ZN
      end)
      if iN.StateChanged then
        iN.StateChanged:Connect(function(SN, SN)
          if
            SN == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
            or SN == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
            or SN == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown

            pcall(function()
              R(ON)
            end)
          end
        end)
      end
      pcall(function()
        iN:GetPropertyChangedSignal("PlatformStand"):Connect(function()
          if iN.PlatformStand then
            pcall(function()
              R(ON)
            end)
          end
        end)
      end)
      iN.Died:Connect(function()
        k()
      end)
    end
    if u.Character then
      LN(u.Character)
    end
    _G.__DEATHTrackConn(u.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(R)
      if R:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5) then
        k()
        LN(R)
      else
        task.wait(0.5)
        k()
        LN(R)
      end
    end))
  end
  do

    function _cypherStartFollowing(LN)
      LN = LN or u.Character
      local ON, iN =
        LN and (LN:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")),
        LN and (LN:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
      if not ON or not iN then
        return
      end
      if R then
        R:Disconnect()
        R = nil
      end
      _G.__DEATHAceNormalAimbot.nextSwingAt = 0
      _G.__DEATHAceNormalAimbot.swingCooldown = false
      ON.AutoRotate = false
      iN = LN:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or (k())
      if iN and iN.Parent ~= LN then
        pcall(ON.EquipTool, ON, iN)
      end
      R = D.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not y.Aimbot then
          return

        if not LN then
          return
        end
        local ON, iN = LN:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), LN:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not ON or not iN then
          return
        end
        if iN.AutoRotate then
          iN.AutoRotate = false
        end
        local SN = LN:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or (k())
        if SN and SN.Parent ~= LN then
          pcall(iN.EquipTool, iN, SN)
        end
        LN = nil
        if _.getMarkerCFrame then
          local ZN, YN = pcall(_.getMarkerCFrame)
          LN = if ZN then YN else LN
        end
        local ZN, YN
        iN = _G.__DEATHGetVisualEnemy and (_G.__DEATHGetVisualEnemy())
        if iN and iN ~= u and iN.Character then
          local jN, eN =
            iN.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
            iN.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
          if jN and eN and eN.Health > 0 then
            ZN, YN = jN, (c(jN))
          end
        end
        if not LN and (not ZN or not YN) then
          return
        end
        _G.__DEATHAceNormalAimbot.target = LN or ZN
        iN, ZN = ON.Position, (LN or YN).Position
        LN = ZN - iN
        local c, jN, eN =
          Vector3.new(LN.X, 0, LN.Z),
          y["Lagger Aimbot"] and 34 or (Z == "Lagger" and 40 or 58),
          Vector3.zero
        eN = if c.Magnitude >= 0.01 then c.Unit * jN else eN
        jN = (ZN.Y - iN.Y) * 19.5
        jN = math.clamp(jN, -70, 110)
        ON.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(eN.X, jN, eN.Z)
        if (ZN - iN).Magnitude > 0.1 then
          c = CFrame.lookAt(iN, ZN)
          YN, LN, jN = (ON.CFrame:Inverse() * c):ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
          YN, LN, jN =
            math.clamp(YN, -2.5, 2.5), math.clamp(LN, -2.5, 2.5), math.clamp(jN, -2.5, 2.5)
          ON.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
            ON.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(YN * 42, LN * 42, jN * 42))
        end
        c = tick()
        if SN and c >= (_G.__DEATHAceNormalAimbot.nextSwingAt or 0) then
          _G.__DEATHAceNormalAimbot.nextSwingAt = c + 0.08
          pcall(SN.Activate, SN)
        end
      end)
    end

      end

    do
      pcall(function()
        local R = workspace:FindFirstChild("PredictionSphere")

      local function ON(iN)
        if #iN == 0 then
          return Vector3.zero
        end
        local SN = Vector3.zero
        for ZN, ZN in ipairs(iN) do
          SN += ZN
        end
        return SN / #iN

      local function iN(SN, ZN, YN)
        table.insert(SN, ZN)
        if #SN > YN then
          table.remove(SN, 1)
        end
      end
      local function SN()
        R.targetPlayer = nil

              if qN < jN then

        jN.AssemblyAngularVelocity = qN.Magnitude > 0.01 and qN.Unit * eN * 80 or Vector3.zero
      end

        end)

          R.realPingMs = math.floor(qN)

            kN and (kN:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))

              else kN

            if LN.Magnitude > c.MAX_HORIZONTAL_VELOCITY then
              LN = LN.Unit * c.MAX_HORIZONTAL_VELOCITY
              kN = (Vector3.new(LN.X, kN.Y, LN.Z))
            end
            iN(R.accelerationHistory, (kN - R.targetVelocity) / SN, 4)
            iN(R.velocityHistory, kN, 8)
            iN(R.verticalVelocityHistory, kN.Y, 5)
            R.targetVelocity = kN
            R.smoothedVelocity = R.smoothedVelocity:Lerp(kN, c.VELOCITY_SMOOTHING)
          end
          R.lastTargetPos = k

    local function YN(eN)
      pcall(function()
        if _G.__DEATHPreserveOptimizerUI(eN) then
          return
        end
        local qN = u.Character
        if qN and (eN == qN or (eN:IsDescendantOf(qN))) then
          return
        end
        if eN:IsDescendantOf(n) then
          return
        end
        if
          eN:IsA("Sky")
          or (eN:IsA("Atmosphere"))
          or (eN:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect"))
          or (eN:IsA("BloomEffect"))
          or (eN:IsA("BlurEffect"))
          or (eN:IsA("Sparkles"))
          or (eN:IsA("PostEffect"))
        then
          return
        end
        if not (F == "Ultra") then
          if
            eN:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
            or (eN:IsA("Trail"))
            or (eN:IsA("Smoke"))
            or (eN:IsA("Fire"))
            or (eN:IsA("Sparkles"))
            or (eN:IsA("PostEffect"))
          then
            eN.Enabled = false
          end
          if tick() <= iN and (eN:IsA("Decal") or (eN:IsA("Texture"))) then
            eN.Transparency = 1
          end
          return
        end
        if
          eN:IsA("Accessory")
          or (eN:IsA("Hat"))
          or (eN:IsA("Clothing"))
          or (eN:IsA("Shirt"))
          or (eN:IsA("Pants"))
          or (eN:IsA("ShirtGraphic"))
        then
          eN:Destroy()
        elseif eN:IsA("BasePart") then
          eN.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
          eN.Reflectance = 0
          eN.CastShadow = false
        elseif eN:IsA("Decal") or (eN:IsA("Texture")) then
          eN.Transparency = 1
        elseif
          eN:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
          or (eN:IsA("Trail"))
          or (eN:IsA("Beam"))
          or (eN:IsA("Fire"))
          or (eN:IsA("Smoke"))
          or (eN:IsA("Sparkles"))
        then
          eN.Enabled = false
        elseif eN:IsA("AnimationController") or (eN:IsA("Animator")) then
          for qN, qN in ipairs(eN:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
            pcall(function()
              qN:Stop(0)
            end)
          end
        end
      end)
    end
    local function eN(qN)
      if UN then
        UN()
      end
      local KN = F == "Ultra" and { workspace } or { workspace, n }
      UN = _G.__DEATHWalkDescendantsBatched(KN, YN, function()
        return x and qN == hN
      end)
    end
    local function qN()
      if LN.Brightness == nil then
        LN.Brightness, LN.ClockTime, LN.OutdoorAmbient = n.Brightness, n.ClockTime, n.OutdoorAmbient
      end
      if ON.Decoration == nil then
        local KN = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
        if KN then
          ON = {
            terrain = KN,
            Decoration = KN.Decoration,
            WaterWaveSize = KN.WaterWaveSize,
            WaterWaveSpeed = KN.WaterWaveSpeed,
            WaterReflectance = KN.WaterReflectance,
          }
        end
      end
      if F == "Normal" then
        pcall(function()
          settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01
        end)
        pcall(function()
          n.GlobalShadows = false
          n.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0
          n.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0
        end)
      else
        pcall(function()
          n.GlobalShadows = false
          n.FogEnd = 10000000000
          n.Brightness = 1
          n.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0
          n.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0
        end)
      end
      local KN = ON.terrain
      if KN then
        pcall(function()
          KN.Decoration = false
          KN.WaterWaveSize = 0
          KN.WaterWaveSpeed = 0
          KN.WaterReflectance = 0
        end)
      end
      for KN, KN in ipairs(n:GetChildren()) do
        if KN:IsA("PostEffect") then
          pcall(function()
            KN.Enabled = false
          end)
        end
      end
    end
    local function KN()
      pcall(function()
        if LN.Brightness ~= nil then
          n.Brightness = LN.Brightness
          n.ClockTime = LN.ClockTime
          n.OutdoorAmbient = LN.OutdoorAmbient
        end
        n.ExposureCompensation = 0
        n.GlobalShadows = true
        n.FogEnd = 100000
        n.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 1
        n.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 1
      end)
      local LN = ON.terrain
      if LN then
        pcall(function()
          LN.Decoration = ON.Decoration
          LN.WaterWaveSize = ON.WaterWaveSize
          LN.WaterWaveSpeed = ON.WaterWaveSpeed
          LN.WaterReflectance = ON.WaterReflectance
        end)
      end
    end
    local function LN()
      if not x then
        return
      end
      x, ZN = false, false
      hN += 1
      SN += 1
      if UN then
        UN()
        UN = nil
      end
      if t then
        t:Disconnect()
        t = nil
      end
      if nN then
        nN:Disconnect()
        nN = nil
      end
      if QN then
        QN:Disconnect()
        QN = nil
      end
      KN()
    end
    local function UN()
      if x then
        return
      end
      x, ZN = true, true
      hN += 1
      local ON = hN
      if F == "Normal" then
        iN = tick() + 1
        SN += 1
        local F = SN
        task.spawn(function()
          jN(F)
        end)
      end
      qN()
      eN(ON)
      t = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(F)
        if x and ON == hN then
          YN(F)
        end
      end)
      nN = n.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(F)
        if x and ON == hN then
          YN(F)
        end
      end)
      QN = u.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(F)
        task.delay(0.5, function()
          if x and ON == hN then
            eN(ON)
          end
        end)
      end)
      task.spawn(function()
        while x and ON == hN do
          task.wait(20)
          if x and ON == hN then
            eN(ON)
          end
        end
      end)
    end
    T.Optimizer = function(F)
      if F then
        UN()
      else
        LN()
      end
    end
    _G.__DEATHTrackStopper(LN)
  end
  R(_N, "FOV", "Custom FOV")
  do
    local F, x, t = false
    local function nN()
      if F then
        return
      end
      F = true
      y["Custom FOV"] = true
      if x then
        x:Disconnect()
      end
      local QN = workspace.CurrentCamera
      local UN = QN and t == nil
      if UN then
        t = QN.FieldOfView
      end
      x = D.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not F then
          return
        end
        local UN, hN = workspace.CurrentCamera, J.FOV or 90
        if UN and math.abs(UN.FieldOfView - hN) > 0.01 then
          UN.FieldOfView = hN
        end
      end)
      if QN then
        QN.FieldOfView = J.FOV or 90
      end
      task.defer(oN)
    end
    local function QN()
      if not F then
        return
      end
      F = false
      y["Custom FOV"] = false
      if x then
        x:Disconnect()
        x = nil
      end
      local F = workspace.CurrentCamera
      if F then
        F.FieldOfView = t or 90
      end
      t = nil
      task.defer(oN)
    end
    T["Custom FOV"] = function(F)
      if F then
        nN()
      else
        QN()
      end
    end
    _G.__DEATHTrackStopper(QN)
    if y["Custom FOV"] then
      task.defer(nN)
    end
  end
  fN(_N, "Stretchz Res", "Stretchz Res")
  do
    local F, x = false

        end)

      t(90)
      task.defer(oN)

    local function t()
      F = false
      y["Stretchz Res"] = false
      if x then
        x:Disconnect()
        x = nil
      end
      local F = workspace.CurrentCamera
      if F then
        pcall(function()
          F.FieldOfView = 90
        end)
      end
      task.defer(oN)
    end

    end

  do
    local F = _G.__DEATHSkinChangerState
    if type(F) ~= "table" or F.version ~= 2 then
      if type(F) == "table" and u.Character then
        local x, t =
          F.originals and F.originals[u.Character], u.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if typeof(x) == "Instance" and t then
          pcall(function()
            t:ApplyDescription(x:Clone())
          end)
        end
      end
      F = { version = 2, originals = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }), templates = {} }
      _G.__DEATHSkinChangerState = F
    end
    F.isHair = function(x)
      if not x:IsA("Accessory") then
        return false
      end
      local t, nN = pcall(function()
        return x.AccessoryType == Enum.AccessoryType.Hair
      end)
      return t and nN or x:FindFirstChild("HairAttachment", true) ~= nil
    end
    F.resolveTemplate = function(x, t, nN)
      local QN = t .. ":" .. tostring(x)
      if F.templates[QN] then
        return F.templates[QN]
      end
      local UN = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(x)
      local hN, LN = pcall(function()
        return game:GetObjects(UN)
      end)
      if hN and LN and LN[1] then
        local hN = LN[1]
        x = hN:IsA(t) and hN or (hN:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(t, true))
        if x and x[nN] ~= "" then
          UN = x[nN]
        end
        pcall(function()
          hN:Destroy()
        end)
      end
      F.templates[QN] = UN
      return UN
    end
    F.removeChanged = function(x)
      for t, t in ipairs(x:GetChildren()) do
        if
          t:IsA("Shirt")
          or (t:IsA("Pants"))
          or t.Name == "DEATHSkinChanger_Hair"
          or (F.isHair(t))
        then
          pcall(function()
            t:Destroy()
          end)
        end
      end
    end
    F.capture = function(x)
      if F.originals[x] then
        return
      end
      local t = { items = {} }
      for nN, nN in ipairs(x:GetChildren()) do
        if nN:IsA("Shirt") or (nN:IsA("Pants")) or (F.isHair(nN)) then
          table.insert(t.items, nN:Clone())
        end
      end
      F.originals[x] = t
    end
    F.presets = {
      V1 = { shirt = 74707712629633, pants = 12405320750, hair = 140188532534398 },
      V2 = { shirt = 101796619834594, pants = 18975891159, hair = 115520061093937 },
      V3 = { shirt = 18552805597, pants = 5414143509, hair = 84008082880128 },
    }
    F.attachHair = function(x, t, nN, QN)
      local UN, hN = pcall(function()
        return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(nN))
      end)
      if not UN or not hN or not hN[1] then
        warn("[Skin Changer] No se pudo cargar el pelo " .. tostring(nN) .. ": " .. tostring(hN))
        return false
      end
      local nN = hN[1]
      UN = nN:IsA("Accessory") and nN or (nN:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Accessory", true))
      if not UN then
        nN:Destroy()
        warn("[Skin Changer] El asset de pelo no contiene un Accessory")
        return false
      end
      local hN = UN:Clone()
      hN.Name = "DEATHSkinChanger_Hair"
      pcall(function()
        nN:Destroy()
      end)
      local nN, LN = x:FindFirstChild("Head"), hN:FindFirstChild("Handle")
      if not nN or not LN or not LN:IsA("BasePart") then
        hN:Destroy()
        warn("[Skin Changer] Falta Head o Handle para colocar el pelo")
        return false
      end
      if not y["Skin Changer"] or u.Character ~= x or F.generation ~= QN then
        hN:Destroy()
        return false
      end
      UN, QN = pcall(function()
        for ON, ON in ipairs(hN:GetDescendants()) do
          if ON:IsA("BasePart") then
            ON.Anchored = false
            ON.CanCollide = false
            ON.Massless = true
            ON.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
          end
        end
        LN.Transparency = 0
        pcall(function()
          t:AddAccessory(hN)
        end)
        hN.Parent = x
        local x, t
        for ON, iN in ipairs(LN:GetChildren()) do
          if iN:IsA("Attachment") then
            ON = nN:FindFirstChild(iN.Name)
            if ON and (ON:IsA("Attachment")) then
              x, t = iN, ON
              break
            end
          end
        end
        local ON, iN, SN =
          x and x.CFrame or hN.AttachmentPoint,
          t and t.CFrame or (CFrame.new(0, nN.Size.Y / 2, 0)),
          LN:FindFirstChild("AccessoryWeld")
        if SN then
          SN:Destroy()
        end
        LN.CFrame = nN.CFrame * iN * ON:Inverse()
        SN = Instance.new("Weld")
        SN.Name = "AccessoryWeld"
        SN.Part0 = LN
        SN.Part1 = nN
        SN.C0 = ON
        SN.C1 = iN
        SN.Parent = LN
      end)
      if not UN then
        hN:Destroy()
        warn("[Skin Changer] No se pudo colocar el pelo: " .. tostring(QN))
      end
      return UN
    end
    F.apply = function(x, t)
      F.generation = (F.generation or 0) + 1
      local nN = F.generation
      t = t or u.Character
      if not t then
        return false
      end
      local QN = t:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or (t:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10))
      if not QN then
        return false
      end
      if nN ~= F.generation then
        return false
      end
      if x then
        local x = F.presets[S] or F.presets.V1
        local UN, hN =
          F.resolveTemplate(x.shirt, "Shirt", "ShirtTemplate"),
          F.resolveTemplate(x.pants, "Pants", "PantsTemplate")
        if nN ~= F.generation or not y["Skin Changer"] or u.Character ~= t then
          return false
        end
        F.capture(t)
        F.removeChanged(t)
        local LN = Instance.new("Shirt")
        LN.Name = "DEATHSkinChanger_Shirt"
        LN.ShirtTemplate = UN
        LN.Parent = t
        LN = Instance.new("Pants")
        LN.Name = "DEATHSkinChanger_Pants"
        LN.PantsTemplate = hN
        LN.Parent = t
        return F.attachHair(t, QN, x.hair, nN)
      end
      nN = F.originals[t]
      F.removeChanged(t)
      if not nN then
        return false
      end
      for x, x in ipairs(nN.items) do
        local nN = x:Clone()
        if nN:IsA("Accessory") then
          pcall(function()
            QN:AddAccessory(nN)
          end)
        else
          nN.Parent = t
        end
      end
      return true
    end
    T["Skin Changer"] = function(x)
      task.spawn(function()
        if x ~= (y["Skin Changer"] == true) then
          return
        end
        F.apply(x == true, u.Character)
      end)
    end
    _G.__DEATHTrackConn(u.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(x)
      if not y["Skin Changer"] then
        return
      end
      task.wait(0.75)
      if y["Skin Changer"] then
        F.apply(true, x)
      end
    end))
    if y["Skin Changer"] then

    end

      if not nN or not nN:IsA("BasePart") then

            headTransparency = nN.Transparency,
            headLocalTransparency = nN.LocalTransparencyModifier,

          for UN, UN in ipairs(nN:GetChildren()) do

              table.insert(QN.faces, { item = UN, transparency = UN.Transparency })

        nN.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1

    function _G.__DEATHReadSavedPanelVisibility(c)
      if typeof(readfile) ~= "function" or typeof(isfile) ~= "function" then
        return false, false
      end
      local t, nN = pcall(function()
        if not isfile(c) then
          return nil
        end
        return Q:JSONDecode(readfile(c))
      end)
      if not t or type(nN) ~= "table" then
        return false, false
      end
      return true, nN.visible == true
    end
    local function c(t)
      if t == nil then
        t = true
      end
      if t and _G.DEATHBypass and _G.DEATHBypass.SetVisible then
        pcall(_G.DEATHBypass.SetVisible, false)
      end
      local nN = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
      local QN = nN and (nN:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui"))
      if QN and (QN:FindFirstChild("DEATHLaggerGUI")) then
        nN = QN:FindFirstChild("DEATHLaggerGUI")
        if nN and t then
          nN.Visible = true
        end
        if _G.DEATHLagger and _G.DEATHLagger.SetVisible then
          _G.DEATHLagger.SetVisible(t)
        end
        return
      end
      if _G._DEATHLaggerGUILoaded then
        _G._DEATHLaggerGUILoaded = false
      end
      _G._DEATHLaggerGUILoaded = true
      _G.__openLaggerGUI = c
      task.spawn(function()
        pcall(function()
          local nN = z.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
          local QN = nN:FindFirstChild("DEATHLaggerGUI")
          if QN then
            QN:Destroy()
          end
          local UN, yN, HN, hN, LN =
            {
              TableIncrease = 270,
              Tries = 1,
              LoopWaitTime = 0.3,
              LowEndTableIncrease = 265,
              LowEndLoopWaitTime = 0.8,
            }, { Main = false, LowEnd = false }, { Main = nil, LowEnd = nil }
          local function ON(iN)
            local SN, ZN = {}, { {} }
            local YN = ZN[1]
            for jN = 1, iN, 1 do
              jN = {}
              table.insert(YN, jN)
              YN = jN
            end
            for YN = 1, math.min(499999 / (iN + 2), 1500), 1 do
              table.insert(SN, ZN)
            end
            return SN
          end
          local function iN(SN)
            if hN ~= SN or not LN then
              hN = SN
              LN = ON(SN)
            end
            pcall(function()
              game:GetService("RobloxReplicatedStorage").SetPlayerBlockList:FireServer(LN)
            end)
          end
          local function hN()
            if HN.Main then
              return
            end
            HN.Main = task.spawn(function()
              while yN.Main do
                local LN, ON, SN =
                  p and 25000 or math.huge,
                  p and (math.min(UN.TableIncrease, UN.LowEndTableIncrease)) or UN.TableIncrease,
                  p and UN.LowEndLoopWaitTime or UN.LoopWaitTime
                pcall(function()
                  game:GetService("NetworkClient"):SetOutgoingKBPSLimit(LN)
                end)
                iN(ON)
                task.wait(SN)
              end
            end)
          end
          local function LN()
            if HN.LowEnd then
              return
            end
            HN.LowEnd = task.spawn(function()
              while yN.LowEnd do
                pcall(function()
                  game:GetService("NetworkClient"):SetOutgoingKBPSLimit(25000)
                end)
                iN(UN.LowEndTableIncrease)
                task.wait(UN.LowEndLoopWaitTime)
              end
            end)
          end
          local function ON(iN)
            if HN[iN] then
              task.cancel(HN[iN])
              HN[iN] = nil
            end
          end
          local function iN()
            yN.Main = false
            yN.LowEnd = false
            ON("Main")
            ON("LowEnd")
            HN.Payload = nil
            HN.PayloadAmount = nil
            HN.Remote = nil
            pcall(function()
              game:GetService("NetworkClient"):SetOutgoingKBPSLimit(math.huge)
            end)
          end

          local function HN()
            yN.Main = not yN.Main
            if yN.Main then
              if yN.LowEnd then
                yN.LowEnd = false
                ON("LowEnd")
                if _G.__updateSmallLaggerVisual then
                  _G.__updateSmallLaggerVisual()
                end
              end
              hN()
            else
              ON("Main")
              if not yN.LowEnd then
                pcall(function()
                  game:GetService("NetworkClient"):SetOutgoingKBPSLimit(math.huge)
                end)
              end
            end
            return yN.Main
          end
          local function SN()
            yN.LowEnd = not yN.LowEnd
            if yN.LowEnd then
              if yN.Main then
                yN.Main = false
                ON("Main")
              end
              LN()
            else
              ON("LowEnd")
              if not yN.Main then
                pcall(function()
                  game:GetService("NetworkClient"):SetOutgoingKBPSLimit(math.huge)
                end)
              end
            end
            return yN.LowEnd
          end
          local function ZN(YN)
            if type(YN) ~= "string" or #YN < 16 then
              return false
            end
            local jN, eN, qN =
              YN:sub(1, 8) == "\137PNG\13\10\26\10",
              YN:sub(1, 2) == "\255\216" or YN:find("JFIF", 1, true) ~= nil or YN:find(
                "Exif",
                1,
                true

              YN:sub(1, 4) == "RIFF" and YN:sub(9, 12) == "WEBP"
            return jN or eN or qN
          end

  local function k(d)
    if not d then
      return nil
    end
    if type(d) == "number" then
      return "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(d)
    end
    if type(d) == "string" then
      local c = string.gsub(d, "^%s+", "")
      c = string.gsub(c, "%s+$", "")
      if c == "" then
        return nil
      end
      if string.sub(c, 1, 11) == "rbxassetid://" then
        return c
      end
      if string.match(c, "^%d+$") then
        return "rbxassetid://" .. c
      end
      return c
    end
    return nil
  end

    local function t(v, nN)
      if y[v] == true == nN then
        return
      end
      local QN = FeatureToggles[v]
      if QN then
        pcall(QN)
      end
      if y[v] ~= nN then
        y[v] = nN
        QN = T[v]
        if QN then
          pcall(QN, nN)
        end
      end
      nN = M[v]
      if nN then
        pcall(nN)
      end
      pcall(oN)
    end
